title: Formula for Gravitational Potential Energy Converted to Power
text: Use $$P=\rho{}ghQ, $$ where $$P$$ is the power in watts, $$\rho=1000\,\text{kg/m}**3$$ is the density of water, $$g=9.81\,\text{m/s}**2$$ is the acceleration due to gravity, $$h=150\, \text{m}$$ is the height, and $$Q=650\,\text{m}**3/\text{s}$$ is the flow rate. Remember that $$1\,\text{MW}=10**{6}\,\text{W}$$.
